Part 70 of the "JPG-set from the early internet when every megabyte mattered that after all these years still didn't have a lossless rip" CG series.

Compiles the first two Xonix-style spinoff games in the series; Mayonaka no Nurse Call (3-153) and Nariyamanu Nurse Call (154-345).

Animations at 17, 31, 35, 37, 44, 65, 72, 76, 107, 134, 163, 170, 177, 179, 188, 193, 200, 203, 214, 225, 233, 240, 244, 254, 258, 263, 279, 286, 292, 298, 306, 309, 316, 327, 335 and 343.
